verses.1: Hear this word that the LORD has spoken against you, O children of Israel, against the whole family that I brought up out of the land of Egypt:
verses.2:
“Only you have I known + 3:2 Or chosen 
 from all the families of the earth;
 therefore I will punish you
 for all your iniquities.”
verses.3:
Can two walk together
 without agreeing where to go? + 3:3 Or without an appointment to meet
verses.4:
Does a lion roar in the forest
 when he has no prey?
 Does a young lion growl in his den
 if he has caught nothing?
verses.5:
Does a bird land in a snare
 where no bait has been set?
 Does a trap spring from the ground
 when it has nothing to catch?
verses.6:
If a ram’s horn sounds in a city,
 do the people not tremble?
 If calamity comes to a city,
 has not the LORD caused it?
verses.7:
Surely the Lord GOD does nothing
 without revealing His plan
 to His servants the prophets.
verses.8:
The lion has roared —
 who will not fear?
 The Lord GOD has spoken —
 who will not prophesy?
verses.9:
Proclaim to the citadels of Ashdod
 and to the citadels of Egypt:
 “Assemble on the mountains of Samaria;
 see the great unrest in the city
 and the acts of oppression in her midst.”
verses.10:
“For they know not how to do right,”
 declares the LORD.
 “They store up violence and destruction
 in their citadels.”
verses.11:
Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says:
 “An enemy + 3:11 Or An adversary will surround the land;
 he will pull down your strongholds
 and plunder your citadels.”
verses.12:
This is what the LORD says:
 “As the shepherd snatches from the mouth of the lion
 two legs or a piece of an ear,
 so the Israelites dwelling in Samaria will be rescued
 having just the corner of a bed
 or the cushion of a couch. + 3:12 Or so will the Israelites be snatched away, those who sit in Samaria on the edge of their beds and in Damascus on their couches
verses.13:
Hear and testify against the house of Jacob,
 declares the Lord GOD, the God of Hosts.
verses.14:
On the day I punish Israel for their transgressions,
 I will visit destruction on the altars of Bethel;
 the horns of the altar will be cut off,
 and they will fall to the ground.
verses.15:
I will tear down the winter house
 along with the summer house;
 the houses of ivory will also perish,
 and the great houses will come to an end,”
 declares the LORD.
